message:
Planning starts in the new year? Start with the venue.

Book it as early as you can, ideally 12+ months out. The date isn't truly fixed, and other vendors can't be booked, until the venue is signed.

What to ask before you sign:
https://bridalteam.com/guides/how-to-choose-a-wedding-venue?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=2026-12&utm_content=2026-12-31-noon-venue-first
